# Strict open-project grammar and project rejection have no mutation-capable path.
assert-exit 64 zwm o
stderr '^zwm: usage: o requires a project name or path\n$'
assert-log $ZWM_TEST_LOG empty-log

assert-exit 64 zwm o project extra
stderr '^zwm: usage: o accepts exactly one project name or path\n$'
assert-log $ZWM_TEST_LOG empty-log

mkdir $WORK/not-an-open-project
assert-exit 65 zwm o $WORK/not-an-open-project
stderr '^zwm: project: project .+ is not a Git worktree\n$'
assert-log $ZWM_TEST_LOG want-log

-- empty-log --
-- want-log --
{"sequence":1,"command":"git","args":["rev-parse","--show-toplevel"],"cwd":"$WORK/not-an-open-project"}
